purpose: 이웃 센터 접점 사건 3장, 계절 중간 점검 3장, 수강생 이야기 5장
tool: ChatGPT 이미지 생성으로 추정 (제작자가 2026-11-19에 앞선 전달분을 두고 '그림을 만든 도구는 모두 chatgp imagen'이라고 알려 줌. 이 전달분은 따로 확인받지 않았고 정확한 모델명도 확인하지 못함)
style: Landscape 3:2, precise ink contours, hand painted rich natural colors, Korean slice-of-life management game, warm daylight, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, complete heads safely framed, adults and seniors of varied ages in everyday Korean clothing.
processing: 전달받은 WebP는 수정하지 않음. sharp로 WebP(quality 84)로 다시 저장: 사건 1200x800(public/center/milestones-v1/), 중간 점검과 이야기 900x600(public/center/midseason-v1/, public/center/stories-v1/). 잘라내기·보정·글자 추가 없음.
review: 11장 모두 축소판(장당 960x640)으로 열어 확인: 지정한 장면과 일치, 읽히는 글자·로고는 보이지 않음(포스터·전단·수료증·편지는 빈 면). joint-event, midseason-promotion, midseason-repair, story-contest 배경에 남산타워를 닮은 탑이 보인다. midseason-repair는 프롬프트의 빈 스튜디오와 달리 뒤쪽에 수강생이 있다. 사람이 아닌 Claude Code가 본 것임.

assets.prompt: A director from a neighboring community center visiting to look around, shaking hands with staff in a bright lobby, friendly rivalry in their smiles.
Two community center teams in different coloured staff lanyards co-hosting an outdoor neighborhood sports day, tug-of-war in the background.
A popular instructor apologetically telling a staff member about an offer from another center, both standing in a studio doorway, respectful and slightly awkward.
A short mid-season staff meeting around a small table in a community center office, a wall calendar with blank squares half filled with stickers, three staff discussing calmly.
Staff pinning colourful blank posters on a neighborhood noticeboard and handing blank flyers to passers-by on a sunny street corner.
A facility staff member doing quick maintenance on exercise equipment in an empty studio between classes, toolbox open, tidy and efficient.
Adult craft class students nervously and proudly setting up their first small exhibition in a community center corridor.
A modest completion ceremony for a digital skills class, seniors holding certificates with blank paper, an instructor clapping.
A community dance class returning with a small trophy from a local contest, hugging in the studio, the instructor wiping a happy tear.
Two residents who met in a class chatting over tea in the community center lounge, one much older than the other, an easy friendship.
An instructor reading a handwritten thank-you letter shown as a page with soft illegible strokes in a quiet classroom after class, touched.
